description: This file defines recommended configuration options for setting up a Kubernetes API server, including options for Etcd, security, authentication, authorization, auditing, features, core API, admission, egress, and tracing. It provides functions to create, configure, and validate these options.

classes.name: RecommendedOptions
classes.description: Struct holding recommended configuration options for Kubernetes API server.

methods.name: NewRecommendedOptions
methods.description: Creates a new RecommendedOptions instance with default settings.

methods.name: AddFlags
methods.description: Adds command-line flags for all options.

methods.name: ApplyTo
methods.description: Applies the options to the server configuration.
